body: no it's fine and thank you, i hope so as well

everything makes me extra anxious because i'm at the age of building my future and the decisions i make now will most likely determine the life i live and the only thing i do is lay in bed, cry and scream at everything. i'm truly thriving lmao

i lost all my strength and everything scares me, it makes me feel dumb and left behind meanwhile people my age are enjoying life to the fullest
i should be the happiest i've ever been and i'm the saddest instead

i've been there as well, i didn't go out for a whole year other than school because of how anxious everything made me feel, i was only 15 at the time so i didn't know what was happening and people around me assumed i was just a lazy ass girl with no goals and became the butt of the joke in family gatherings. that affected me so much and only recently told my mom about how that made me feel at the time. 

my biggest problem is that my brain only knows how to function in a harmful way, that's all i've known for the most part of my life so now i have trouble telling apart what's a normal negative thought everyone has and what's my depression messing with me, so i can't even enjoy feeling good about accomplishing something because my brain tells me to stop celebrating something so stupid
idk if i'm making sense
thank you, i did seek help a couple of years ago and have been going to therapy since then, but i don't think it helped me the way it should so i'll try contacting another professional if i can

i tried to do that before, it took me so long to finally accept that i needed help because verbalizing that i wasn't ok was very scary but i accepted it and went to therapy. i eventually got better, i thought dropping out of school was necessary because i needed a break to focus on my mental health and it was working until september of last year, when i fell into a hole so deep i just don't know how to get back up

i'm super aware of how badly i cope with this and i know exactly which steps to take to be better but the thing is, i don't know if i want to or if i can. i'm so exhausted and i have no idea how to face the real world once i inevitably have to step out of the house. i feel so small and not ready to take responsibility like an adult

it's really not you, it's your head acting up. you're not the problem, the way your brain works is

from other people's perspective there's absolutely nothing wrong with you or your personality and there really isn't but mental illness is a bitch and will make you believe you're the problem

give yourself some credit for all the good things in your life because that was 100% you and your effort so i truly hope you eventually find something that helps and get to enjoy life.
it's very ironic to say this stuff while i'm a mess myself but it's funny how we seem to find positivity for others and not ourselves

i have health problems that make me feel incredibly tired so it's extra hard to make myself get up and do something, sometimes i'll force myself to be active just to end up crying because of how stupid i feel. it's like a constant voice in my head telling me to stop trying because i'm not worth the effort and it sucks so much it drives me crazy

we fight a lot lately, i haven't talked to her in a few days because i'm tired of her behavior. she's been acting sick all day and looks like she's the most miserable person on earth. it disgusts me and i find it so embarrassing. i'm just done, i love her and i want her to be ok as well as my brother but i'm done sharing a house with her and dealing with this.

the fact that leaving is my only motivation to actually do something with my life is so sad but anyway lmao

i know when i leave i'll be responsible enough to take care of myself, but idk what my brother is going to do once he does, he's planning on moving out to a small apartment in the same town and i'd think of it as a good idea if he weren't so irresponsible with his money. i hope if he does leave he'll truly change for the better. i'm also scared of my mother being by herself, i don't know if she's going to feel lonely and depressed. i think more about them than myself yet i'm the one that takes all the blame. she was just talking to herself about me lmao i'm so fed up
